about: Cão Zumbi (zombieDog) remade from the user's 720p videos (2026-11-11, "Creatures Remade, lets start with the zombie dog"; 24 fps, 1280 x 720): BigZombie_dog_animation_reference_ba9abcc5 (idle, cast), BigZombie_dog_walk_and_attack_6e721e64 (walk, attack), BigZombie_dog_animation_reference_efc4c366 (hit, death). Only the clips the dog already has in the game are cut (the user: "dont waste time making animations we dont use"). Alta + 64 + 36 (the 64 / 36 copies by tools/scripts/sprites/quality_copies.py). The user: "make him 25% smaller than he used to be". The frames are first values read off the videos: the user judges.
figureNote: Ember's zombieDog idle stands 255 px ear tips to paws in a 321 px frame whose box is 3.75728 units tall: 2.985 units. 75% of that is 2.2387 units. In the 720p idle the dog is 512.5 px ear tips to paws (median of 60 frames); the three videos share one camera, so every clip keeps that one pixel scale.
